blocks.en: Nearly all E-Uni classes are open to the wider EVE-playing public. For more details on our classes and how to join them, please see Attending classes.
blocks.zh: 几乎所有 E-Uni 课程都向广大 EVE 玩家开放。关于课程详情和参加方式，请参阅参加课程。

blocks.en: For a list of upcoming classes see the Discord Events feature, which serves as our EVE University Calendar. Visit EVE University YouTube Channel to find recordings of classes, mini-tutorials, and other educational content.
blocks.zh: 近期课程列表请查看 Discord 的活动（Events）功能，它就是我们的 EVE University 日程表。课程录像、迷你教程等教学内容可以在 EVE University YouTube 频道找到。

blocks.en: The easiest way to do so is via our public Discord channel (# educators-corner).
blocks.zh: 最简单的方式是通过我们的公开 Discord 频道（# educators-corner）。

blocks.en: EVE University offers a wide variety of classes on different topics of EVE Online. These can take the form of presentations, workshops, Q&As, and talks.
blocks.zh: EVE University 开设了涵盖 EVE Online 各方面主题的多种课程，形式包括演讲、实操工作坊、问答（Q&A）和讲座。

blocks.en: In order to increase the accessibility of the University's content, the Teaching Department maintains a public folder of all our teaching material, including slideshows, PDFs, and teacher notes. You can access this class folder here.
blocks.zh: 为了让大学的内容更易获取，教学部维护着一个公开文件夹，收录了我们全部的教学资料，包括幻灯片、PDF 和讲师笔记。你可以在这里访问该课程文件夹。

blocks.en: Please keep in mind that not all teaching resources are actively maintained. Some slide-decks may have outdated information, obsolete information, or content in other ways irrelevant to EVE today. If you notice something that requires updating, or if you'd like to contribute to our public class library in some way, please let us know by reaching out to any member of the Teaching Department in our public Discord, or via EVEMail.
blocks.zh: 请注意，并非所有教学资料都在持续维护。部分幻灯片可能包含过时、已失效或因其他原因与当前 EVE 无关的内容。如果你发现有需要更新的地方，或想以某种方式为我们的公开课程资料库做贡献，请在我们的公开 Discord 中或通过 EVE 邮件联系教学部的任意成员。
